BTX_GerHQRadar.name: HQ Radar
BTX_GerHQRadar.description: A rotating radar dish on the HQ. Friendly units within 30 m get <Text_Accent>+20% weapon range</>.
BTX_GerHQRadar.facts: Ger_Bxp_HQRadar BP: URadiusImprovedRangeAura, Radius 3000 (read from asset), BehaviourTypes = BP_Beh_Weapon_20Range (RangeMlt 1.2 read from asset, text '+20%'); base IsValidTarget accepts any actor in the searched relation (AOEBehaviourComponent.cpp:114). Energy -5, cost 200 R / 180 M (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:431-449, Source/RTS_Survival/DeveloperSettings.h:927).

BTX_GerHQPlatform.name: Flak Platform
BTX_GerHQPlatform.description: A raised platform with a 3.7 cm Flak 36 firing <Text_Weapon>6-round clips</>. The height gives it <Text_Accent>double range</> (+100%).
BTX_GerHQPlatform.facts: Turret RTS_BP_EmbTurret_37mmFlak, weapon Flak36_37MM: MagCapacity 6, reload 5 s (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:4030); BP adds BP_Beh_Weapon_HQDoubleRange to the turret (RangeMlt 2.0 read from asset, text '+100%'). Health T1BxpHealth*1.25, energy -5 (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:451-469). Old row had the typo 'though'.

BTX_GerHQHarvester.name: Harvester Hub
BTX_GerHQHarvester.description: A research platform on the HQ. Unlocks <Text_Accent>economy research</>: harvester capacity and speed, scavenging speed and reward, stronger repairs and Barricades.
BTX_GerHQHarvester.facts: Ger_Bxp_HQHarvesterHub BP has ResearchTechnologyAbility comps for Tech_HarvesterCapacity (+50 R / +25 M per Pz I harvester), Tech_HarvesterSpeed (2x harvest anim rate), Tech_ScavengingSpeed (x1.25), Tech_ScavengingReward (x1.2), Tech_RepairUpgrade (repair x1.33), Tech_Barricades (building health x1.2) - see TechTree/Technologies/GerTechnologies/*/TE_*.cpp. No energy; cost 300 R / 150 M (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:410-428).

BTX_GerHQRepairBay.name: Repair Bay
BTX_GerHQRepairBay.description: A repair pad with two welding cranes. Repairs damaged vehicles and buildings within 35 m by <Text_Accent>10 HP per second</>.
BTX_GerHQRepairBay.facts: Ger_Bxp_HQRepairBay BP: URadiusRepairAura Radius 3500 (read from asset), BehaviourTypes Behaviour_TickRepair_10_3Sec ('10 HP/s over 3 Seconds', re-applied every 2.25 s tick); targets = tanks/nomadic vehicles and building expansions (RepairHelpers.h:37-49). Health T1BxpHealth*3, energy -5 (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:491-509).

BTX_GerHQTower.name: Guard Tower
BTX_GerHQTower.description: A Panzer IV turret on a tall tower, armed with a <Text_Weapon>7.5 cm KwK 40 L/48</>. The height gives it <Text_Accent>triple range</> (+200%).
BTX_GerHQTower.facts: Ger_Bxp_HQTower BP: child turret Ger_Turret_PanzerIV_F2NoMSmoke, weapon KwK40_L48_75MM (so 'Panzer IV turret' in the old row is correct); BP adds BP_Beh_Weapon_HQTrippleRange (display text '+200%'; float not decoded from asset). BxpData: Health = RoundToNearestMultipleOfFive(15) = 15 HP (likely bug), build T1BxpBuildTime*5, energy -8 (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:471-489).

BTX_RefConverter.name: Radixite Converter
BTX_RefConverter.description: Turns radixite into vehicle parts while switched on: 15 radixite for 5 parts every 6.7 s, <Text_Accent>45 vehicle parts per minute</>.
BTX_RefConverter.facts: Ger_Ref_Converter BP ConversionSettings read from asset: TickRate 6.667, ResourceDeltas Radixite -15 / VehicleParts +5 (option B, uncommitted). BxpData EnergySupply = +10 (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:188) although positive means supply elsewhere; cost 200 R / 100 M.

BTX_RefKaskade.name: Kaskade Distillation
BTX_RefKaskade.description: Three distillation columns and a bank of glass receivers. Adds <Text_Accent>+750 radixite storage</> to this refinery.
BTX_RefKaskade.facts: ExtraResourceStorage Radixite = RefKaskadeExtraRadixiteStorage = RefineryRadixiteStorage/2 = 750 (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:210-215, Source/RTS_Survival/DeveloperSettings.h:83-85). Cost 300 R / 200 M, no energy.

BTX_RefFlakStand.name: Flak Stand
BTX_RefFlakStand.description: A steel stand over the storage tanks with a 3.7 cm Flak 37 and two crew, firing <Text_Weapon>6-round clips</>. The height gives it <Text_Accent>double range</>.
BTX_RefFlakStand.facts: Turret RTS_BP_EmbTurret_SD_FlakStand37, weapon Flak36_37MM_Pit: 6-round clip, 4.5 s clip change (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:4040); BP adds BP_Beh_Weapon_HQDoubleRange (RangeMlt 2.0). Health T1BxpHealth*2, cost 420 R / 220 M (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:218-238). Old row said 8-round mags.
BTX_RefFlakStand.offered_by: Strike Division only: Refinery (Defense), replaces the 37mm Flak there Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:1037-1050

BTX_GerBarracksRadixReactor.name: Radix Reactor
BTX_GerBarracksRadixReactor.description: A radixite reactor for the barracks: <Text_Accent>+8 energy</>. Unlocks Light Bringers (with a Communication Center) and infantry kit, ghillie suit and entrenching research.
BTX_GerBarracksRadixReactor.facts: EnergySupply 8 (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:354). Light Bringers need Comm Center + this BXP (Source/RTS_Survival/GameUI/TrainingUI/TrainingMenuManager.cpp:2780-2799). BP research comps: Tech_Infantry_Kit (line infantry health x1.15), Tech_Sniper_Ghillie (sniper/Gebirgsjager health x1.33), Tech_Pioneer_Entrenching (field defence build speed x1.35). Light Bringers are in both doctrine barracks layouts.

BTX_GerBarrackFuelCell.name: Fuel Cell
BTX_GerBarrackFuelCell.description: A fuel cell bank for the barracks: <Text_Accent>+5 energy</>. Unlocks the Sniper Team (with a Communication Center) and the Flak 88 Ground Role research.
BTX_GerBarrackFuelCell.facts: EnergySupply 5 (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:372). Sniper Team and Feuer Sturm need Comm Center + this BXP (Source/RTS_Survival/GameUI/TrainingUI/TrainingMenuManager.cpp:2639-2707); Feuer Sturm left out of the text because only the Breakthrough barracks layout lists it (Source/RTS_Survival/GameUI/TrainingUI/TrainingLayout/TrainingLayoutDataAsset.cpp:414). BP research comp: Tech_Flak88_GroundRole (ground-fire mode for the 8.8 cm Flak team weapon).

BTX_GerBarracksSniperLoft.name: Sniper Loft
BTX_GerBarracksSniperLoft.description: A timber loft with a <Text_Weapon>Kar98k sniper</> behind sandbags. Covers the front half circle and <Text_Accent>sees 80 m</>.
BTX_GerBarracksSniperLoft.facts: Turret Ger_EIT_Sniper_Kar98, weapon Kar_Sniper (5-round mag, 6 s reload, sniper range) (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:2733). VisionRadius GerBarracksSniperLoftVisionRadius 8000 (Source/RTS_Survival/DeveloperSettings.h:1134). Health T1BxpHealth*1.5, cost 340 R / 160 M (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:376-397).

BTX_GerLFactoryRadixiteReactor.name: Forge Reactor
BTX_GerLFactoryRadixiteReactor.description: A radixite reactor for the forge: <Text_Accent>+10 energy</>. Unlocks vehicle research: autocannon damage, auto loaders, spall liners, rangefinders, tungsten 8.8 cm shells, shell hoists.
BTX_GerLFactoryRadixiteReactor.facts: EnergySupply 10 (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:618). BP research comps list Tech_AutoLoader, Tech_Spalliners (medium armour health x1.2), Tech_StereoRangefinder (casemate TD range/accuracy), Tech_Tungsten88 (long 8.8 pen), Tech_Assault_ShellHoist (heavy assault gun reload -30%) and Tech_AutoCannonDamage (TEBP_Ger_AutoCannonDamage: autocannon damage +33%). Components: AutoCannonTech, SpallLinersTech, RangefinderTungstenTech, ShellHoistTech (Docs/Abilities/GermanTechBatch2.md, Tools/TechSetup/setup_tech_batch2.py RESEARCH_HOSTS). VisionRadius = 100 (line 607).

BTX_GerLFactoryFuelStorage.name: Fuel Storage
BTX_GerLFactoryFuelStorage.description: Fuel tanks for the forge: <Text_Accent>+5 energy</>. Unlocks flame weapon research and Armoured Troop Bay: half-tracks get +20% hull armour and their passengers bail out.
BTX_GerLFactoryFuelStorage.facts: EnergySupply 5 (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:637). BP research comps list Tech_HalfTrack_ArmoredBay (TE_ArmoredTroopBay: hull armour x1.2, passengers bail out at 50% health) plus components FlameRadixiteDmg (Tech_FlameDamage; TE_FlameDamage C++ recolours flame VFX, no damage change found in C++) and FlameRangeOrRailReload (Tech_FlameRange; no C++ effect class or TEBP found). VisionRadius = 100 (line 626).

BTX_GerForgeSchreckFrame.name: Panzerschreck Frame
BTX_GerForgeSchreckFrame.description: A steel frame over the front arch with a Panzerschreck team on a raised deck, firing <Text_Weapon>88mm HEAT rockets</>. <Text_Accent>Strong against tanks up close</>.
BTX_GerForgeSchreckFrame.facts: Turret RTS_BP_EmbTurret_GerPit_Panzerschreck, weapon PanzerSchreck_Pit: HEAT, 1 rocket, 8 s reload, small-arms range (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:4781). Health T1BxpHealth*2, cost 380 R / 220 M (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:641-662).

BTX_GerMetalVaultSmelter.name: Smelter
BTX_GerMetalVaultSmelter.description: A firebrick cupola in the vault tower. Smelts metal into vehicle parts while switched on: 25 metal for 5 parts every 10 s, <Text_Accent>30 parts per minute</>.
BTX_GerMetalVaultSmelter.facts: Ger_Bxp_MetalVaultSmelter ConversionSettings read from asset: TickRate 10, Metal -25 / VehicleParts +5. EnergySupply +10 (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:265), same sign question as the converter. Cost 250 R / 100 M.

BTX_GerMechDepotRadioVan.name: Radio Van
BTX_GerMechDepotRadioVan.description: A Kfz. 17 radio van with a 12 m aerial tower on the container. Gives the depot <Text_Accent>90 m of sight</>, the widest of any expansion.
BTX_GerMechDepotRadioVan.facts: VisionRadius GerMechDepotRadioVanVisionRadius 9000 (Source/RTS_Survival/DeveloperSettings.h:1131; only the Soviet mega bunker sees further). Energy -10, no weapon, cost 320 R / 180 M (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:283-304).

BTX_GerMechDepotWurfrahmenShop.name: Wurfrahmen Shop
BTX_GerMechDepotWurfrahmenShop.description: A lean-to where a 251 is fitted with Wurfrahmen 40 racks. While it stands, your Panzerwerfers <Text_Accent>reload 25% faster</>.
BTX_GerMechDepotWurfrahmenShop.facts: PanzerwerferReloadMlt = 0.75 (Source/RTS_Survival/DeveloperSettings.h:1027, Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:326), applied as ReloadSpeedMlt by BehaviourWeaponWurfrahmenShop.cpp:27 (reload time x0.75). Energy -5, cost 360 R / 220 M.

BTX_GerCommObservationPost.name: Observation Post
BTX_GerCommObservationPost.description: A small concrete bunker with a stereo rangefinder on a sandbag wing end. Unarmed; <Text_Accent>sees 45 m</> from the wing.
BTX_GerCommObservationPost.facts: Only effect in code: VisionRadius T2BxpVisionRadius 4500 (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:521-540; comment 'gameplay role (artillery spotting) is still open'). Reinforced, health T1BxpHealth*1.5, energy -5, cost 250 R / 150 M. Comm Center itself sees 3000.

BTX_GerCommMG42Nests.name: MG42 Nests
BTX_GerCommMG42Nests.description: A raised MG42 nest on each wing end, each with a gunner and a loader. <Text_Weapon>MG 42 on 100-round belts</>. <Text_Accent>Strong against infantry</>.
BTX_GerCommMG42Nests.facts: Turrets Ger_BP_EmbTurret_TwinMG42 (+ _Left via PitAdditionalTurretComponent), weapon Ger_PitMG42_7_92MM: 10-round bursts, 100-round belt, 6 s reload (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:3136). Health BxpHeavyBunkerHealth*0.75, cost 360 R / 160 M (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:126-130).

BTX_GerCommRequisitionOffice.name: Requisition Office
BTX_GerCommRequisitionOffice.description: A requisition cabin hung on the tower. While it stands, <Text_Accent>field defences cost 25% less</>, field trenches included.
BTX_GerCommRequisitionOffice.facts: FieldDefenseCostMlt = 0.75 (Source/RTS_Survival/DeveloperSettings.h:1016, Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:562), registered with the game state on build (BuildingExpansion.cpp:1187-1204); applies to the Global_GetIsFieldDefenseBxpType list incl. the trench per-metre price (BuildingExpansionEnums.h:459-481). Energy -5, cost 300 R / 180 M.

BTX_GerCommCipherRoom.name: Cipher Room
BTX_GerCommCipherRoom.description: A cipher cabin hung over the inner yard. While it stands, <Text_Accent>commander ability cooldowns are 20% shorter</>.
BTX_GerCommCipherRoom.facts: GlobalAbilityCooldownMlt = 0.8 (Source/RTS_Survival/DeveloperSettings.h:1020, Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:587), registered with UGlobalAbilitiesManager (BuildingExpansion.cpp:1227-1245). Energy -10, cost 400 R / 220 M.

BTX_37mmFlak.name: 37mm Flak
BTX_37mmFlak.description: A small emplacement with a 3.7 cm Flak 36 firing <Text_Weapon>6-round clips</>. <Text_Accent>Good against aircraft and light vehicles</>.
BTX_37mmFlak.facts: Turret RTS_BP_EmbTurret_37mmFlak, weapon Flak36_37MM: MagCapacity 6, reload 5 s, pen 45 mm (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:4030). BxpData T1 health/vision, cost 140 R / 80 M (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:8881-8890). Old row said '8-Round Mags' and 'An 37mm'.
BTX_37mmFlak.offered_by: both doctrines: every German building's Defense slot (HQ, Gamma, Refinery (Breakthrough only), Metal Vault, Barracks, Mech Depot, Forge, Comm Center, Armory, Med Tank Factory, Training Centre, Airbase, Experimental Factory)

BXT_88mmFlak.name: 88mm Flak
BXT_88mmFlak.description: A heavy emplacement with the 8.8 cm Flak 37, firing <Text_Weapon>APHE, APCR and HE</> with a 5 s reload. <Text_Accent>Highly effective against armoured targets</>.
BXT_88mmFlak.facts: Turret RTS_BP_EmbTurret_88mmFlak, weapon Flak37_88MM: APHE/APCR/HE, 1 round, 5 s reload (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:5007). BxpData health T1*1.5, cost 420 R / 320 M (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:8892-8901).
BXT_88mmFlak.offered_by: not offered: has data but is in no option list or layout

BTX_LeFH_150mm.name: leFH 18 Howitzer
BTX_LeFH_150mm.description: A 10.5 cm leFH 18 howitzer emplacement firing <Text_Weapon>105mm HE shells</> every 8 s. <Text_Accent>Long-range fire</> against infantry and positions.
BTX_LeFH_150mm.facts: BP RTS_BP_BXP_LeFH105mm, turret RTS_BP_EmbTurret_LeFH_105mm, weapon LeFH_18_105MM: HE, 8 s reload, HowitzerArtilleryRange (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:5136). The type and display string say 150mm but the gun is 105mm. Cost 450 R / 225 M (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:8954-8963).

BXT_SolarLarge.name: Solar Trailer
BXT_SolarLarge.description: A radixite solar trailer parked beside the Gamma Facility. Provides <Text_Accent>+10 energy</>.
BXT_SolarLarge.facts: EnergySupply 10, health T1*1.25, cost 155 R / 90 M (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:8914-8924, Source/RTS_Survival/DeveloperSettings.h:901-902). Socket expansion.

BXT_SolarSmall.name: Small Solar Panel
BXT_SolarSmall.description: A small free-standing radixite solar panel.
BXT_SolarSmall.facts: BxpData never sets EnergySupply, so it is 0 (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:8903-8912); no gameplay effect found. Add '+X energy' once the data is set.
BXT_SolarSmall.offered_by: not offered: has data but is in no option list or layout

BTX_GerMarderStugFactory.name: Marder StuG Factory
BTX_GerMarderStugFactory.description: A walled assembly hall for Marder and StuG tank destroyers, with <Text_Accent>7000 HP</> of reinforced walls.
BTX_GerMarderStugFactory.facts: BxpData: health 7000, reinforced, cost 2000 R / 1000 M, vision 3x T1 (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:8969-8998). BP RTS_BP_GerStugMarderFactory uses the flak bunker mesh + a container and a MarderStug mission 'FactoryLost_LostGame' voice line; no training options, requirements or bonuses reference the type.

BTX_GerCapturedB4Pit.name: Captured B-4 Pit
BTX_GerCapturedB4Pit.description: A captured Soviet <Text_Weapon>B-4 203mm howitzer</> on a turntable; its crew crane-loads every shell (12 s). <Text_Accent>Longest range of any gun pit</>.
BTX_GerCapturedB4Pit.facts: Weapon B4_203MM_Pit: reload 12 s, range HowitzerArtilleryRange*1.25 = 12100 vs sFH 18 11600 (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:5182). BxpData shared with the Soviet pit: vision MegaBunkerVisionRadius 10000, health heavy bunker*1.5, cost 1600 R / 900 M (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:9316-9332).

BTX_GerPak40Pit.name: Pak 40 Pit
BTX_GerPak40Pit.description: A 7.5 cm Pak 40 in a low sandbag ring; gun and crew turn a full circle. Fires <Text_Weapon>APCR</> every 5.9 s. <Text_Accent>Strong against tanks</>.
BTX_GerPak40Pit.facts: Turret RTS_BP_EmbTurret_GerPit_Pak40, weapon Pak40_3_L46_75MM_TW: APCR only, 148 mm pen, 5.9 s reload (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:4453). Health heavy bunker*0.9, cost 380 R / 200 M (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:109). Old row was the 37mm Flak text.
BTX_GerPak40Pit.offered_by: both doctrines: HQ Field Defenses tab, no requirement Source/RTS_Survival/GameUI/TrainingUI/TrainingLayout/TrainingLayoutDataAsset.cpp:217

BTX_GerLeFH18Pit.name: leFH 18 Pit
BTX_GerLeFH18Pit.description: A 10.5 cm leFH 18 in a high sandbag ring with a four-man crew. Fires <Text_Weapon>105mm HE</> every 8 s. <Text_Accent>Long-range fire</> on infantry and positions.
BTX_GerLeFH18Pit.facts: Weapon LeFH_18_105MM_TW: HE, 8 s reload, HowitzerArtilleryRange 9680 (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:5139). Health heavy bunker*1.1, cost 620 R / 320 M (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:110). Needs the Communication Center (Source/RTS_Survival/GameUI/TrainingUI/TrainingMenuManager.cpp:3026-3028). Old row was the 37mm Flak text.
BTX_GerLeFH18Pit.offered_by: both doctrines: HQ Field Defenses tab, needs Comm Center Source/RTS_Survival/GameUI/TrainingUI/TrainingLayout/TrainingLayoutDataAsset.cpp:222

BTX_GerSFH18Pit.name: sFH 18 Pit
BTX_GerSFH18Pit.description: A 15 cm sFH 18 in a high sandbag ring with a four-man crew. Fires <Text_Weapon>150mm HE</> every 14.4 s and <Text_Accent>outranges the leFH 18 by 20%</>.
BTX_GerSFH18Pit.facts: Weapon sFH18_150MM_TW = sIG 33 data (14.4 s reload) with range HowitzerArtilleryRange*1.2 = 11600 (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:5254-5262; the comment there says 10600, the formula gives 11600). Health heavy bunker*1.25, cost 950 R / 520 M (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:111). Needs Comm Center.
BTX_GerSFH18Pit.offered_by: both doctrines: HQ Field Defenses tab, needs Comm Center Source/RTS_Survival/GameUI/TrainingUI/TrainingLayout/TrainingLayoutDataAsset.cpp:223

BTX_GerFlak37Pit.name: Flak 37 Pit
BTX_GerFlak37Pit.description: A 3.7 cm Flak 37 in a sandbag ring; a loader's mate passes up <Text_Weapon>6-round clips</> (4.5 s change). <Text_Accent>Good against aircraft and light vehicles</>.
BTX_GerFlak37Pit.facts: Turret RTS_BP_EmbTurret_GerPit_Flak37, weapon Flak36_37MM_Pit: 6-round clip, 4.5 s reload (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:4040). Health heavy bunker*0.9, cost 420 R / 220 M (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:112). Old row was the generic 37mm Flak text with 8-round mags.
BTX_GerFlak37Pit.offered_by: both doctrines: HQ Field Defenses tab, no requirement Source/RTS_Survival/GameUI/TrainingUI/TrainingLayout/TrainingLayoutDataAsset.cpp:218

BTX_GerFlak88Pit.name: Flak 88 Emplacement
BTX_GerFlak88Pit.description: An 8.8 cm Flak behind high sandbag walls with a three-man drill. Fires <Text_Weapon>APHE, APCR and HE</> every 5 s. <Text_Accent>Strong against tanks at long range</>.
BTX_GerFlak88Pit.facts: Turret RTS_BP_EmbTurret_GerPit_Flak88, weapon Flak37_88MM: APHE/APCR/HE, 5 s reload, HeavyCannonRange (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:5007); pitch limited to 0-10 deg (Docs/Units/GerFlak88Pit.md). Health heavy bunker*1.3, cost 560 R / 360 M. Needs Comm Center.
BTX_GerFlak88Pit.offered_by: both doctrines: HQ Field Defenses tab, needs Comm Center Source/RTS_Survival/GameUI/TrainingUI/TrainingLayout/TrainingLayoutDataAsset.cpp:225

BTX_GerMortarPit.name: Mortar Pit
BTX_GerMortarPit.description: An 8 cm mortar and its two-man crew in a square sandbag pit. Lobs <Text_Weapon>80mm HE</> over cover every 10 s. <Text_Accent>Good against infantry in cover</>.
BTX_GerMortarPit.facts: Turret RTS_BP_EmbTurret_GerPit_Mortar, weapon Mortar_80MM_TW: HE, 1 round, 10 s reload (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:2210). Health heavy bunker*0.8, cost 340 R / 160 M (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:139).
BTX_GerMortarPit.offered_by: both doctrines: HQ Field Defenses tab, no requirement Source/RTS_Survival/GameUI/TrainingUI/TrainingLayout/TrainingLayoutDataAsset.cpp:219

BTX_GerPuppchenPit.name: Puppchen Pit
BTX_GerPuppchenPit.description: A Raketenwerfer 43 'Puppchen' in a small bag ring. Fires <Text_Weapon>88mm HEAT rockets</> every 6 s, further than a Panzerschreck. <Text_Accent>Strong against tanks</>.
BTX_GerPuppchenPit.facts: Weapon Raketenwerfer43_88MM: HEAT, 6 s reload, LightCannonRange vs Panzerschreck small-arms range (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:4794). Health heavy bunker*0.55, cost 280 R / 130 M, 15 s build (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:114-117).
BTX_GerPuppchenPit.offered_by: both doctrines: HQ Field Defenses tab, no requirement Source/RTS_Survival/GameUI/TrainingUI/TrainingLayout/TrainingLayoutDataAsset.cpp:220

BTX_GerPanzerschreckPit.name: Panzerschreck Foxhole
BTX_GerPanzerschreckPit.description: A Panzerschreck team in a foxhole behind a ring of bags, firing <Text_Weapon>88mm HEAT rockets</> every 8 s. <Text_Accent>The cheapest anti-tank defence</>, but fragile.
BTX_GerPanzerschreckPit.facts: Weapon PanzerSchreck_Pit: HEAT, 8 s reload, small-arms range (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:4781). Health heavy bunker*0.4 (lowest), cost 160 R / 60 M (cheapest field defence), 12 s build (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:118-121).
BTX_GerPanzerschreckPit.offered_by: both doctrines: HQ Field Defenses tab, no requirement Source/RTS_Survival/GameUI/TrainingUI/TrainingLayout/TrainingLayoutDataAsset.cpp:224

BTX_GerRailPakBunker.name: Rail Pak Bunker
BTX_GerRailPakBunker.description: A concrete pillbox with a rail-fitted Pak 40 on its roof, firing <Text_Weapon>50mm rail slugs</> that punch through targets. <Text_Accent>Twice as tough as a Pak 40 pit</>.
BTX_GerRailPakBunker.facts: Turret RTS_BP_EmbTurret_GerRailPak, weapon RailGun50MM via SetupRailgunWeapon (rail projectile, over-penetration), 10 s reload (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:3335, Docs/Units/GerRailPakBunker.md). Health heavy bunker*1.8 vs Pak 40 pit 0.9, cost 850 R / 420 M (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:131-135). Needs Comm Center.
BTX_GerRailPakBunker.offered_by: Breakthrough only: HQ Field Defenses tab, needs Comm Center Source/RTS_Survival/GameUI/TrainingUI/TrainingLayout/TrainingLayoutDataAsset.cpp:400-403

BTX_GerTwinMG42Pit.name: Twin MG42 Pit
BTX_GerTwinMG42Pit.description: Two MG 42 nests joined by an ammunition corridor, each with a gunner and a loader. <Text_Weapon>100-round belts</>, 6 s reload. <Text_Accent>Strong against infantry</>.
BTX_GerTwinMG42Pit.facts: Turrets Ger_BP_EmbTurret_TwinMG42 + _Left, weapon Ger_PitMG42_7_92MM: 10-round bursts, 100-round belt, 6 s reload (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:3136). Health heavy bunker*0.75, cost 320 R / 140 M (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:122-125).
BTX_GerTwinMG42Pit.offered_by: both doctrines: HQ Field Defenses tab, no requirement Source/RTS_Survival/GameUI/TrainingUI/TrainingLayout/TrainingLayoutDataAsset.cpp:221

BTX_GerFieldTrench.name: Field Trench
BTX_GerFieldTrench.description: A trench you drag out from the HQ; it is dug piece by piece for <Text_Accent>10 radixite per metre</>. Soldiers inside take trench cover.
BTX_GerFieldTrench.facts: GerFieldTrench_RadixitePerMetre 10 (Source/RTS_Survival/DeveloperSettings.h:1038, Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:156-160); ARTSFieldTrench pays per piece as it digs and hands its cargo sockets to the cover finder as trench cover (Buildings/FieldTrench/RTSFieldTrench.h:66-71). Requisition Office discount applies.

BXT_GerFLakBunker.name: Flak Bunker
BXT_GerFLakBunker.description: A concrete bunker with a 3.7 cm and an 8.8 cm Flak, able to switch to <Text_Weapon>shrapnel rounds</>. <Text_Accent>Very tough</>: 2.5x heavy bunker health.
BXT_GerFLakBunker.facts: BP Ger_BXP_FlakBunker: turrets RTS_BP_EmbTurret_37mmFlak + RTS_BP_EmbTurret_GerPit_Flak88, ApplyBehaviourAbility FlakShrapnelRounds. Health BxpHeavyBunkerHealth*2.5, cost 1600 R / 1500 M (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:8939-8952).
BXT_GerFLakBunker.offered_by: not offered: has data but is in no option list or layout

BTX_20mmFlak.name: 20mm Flak
BTX_20mmFlak.facts: No FBxpData entry in CPPGameState/BxpDataHelpers; BP RTS_BP_BXP_20mmFlak has no turret or weapon; only a construction-rules footprint (BxpConstructionRulesHelpers.h:96) and it is FBxpOptionData's default ExpansionType (BxpOptionData.cpp:5).
BTX_20mmFlak.offered_by: not offered: no data, no turret, in no option list

BTX_Pak38.name: Pak 38
BTX_Pak38.description: A 5 cm Pak 38 emplacement firing <Text_Weapon>APHE</> with a quick 3.3 s reload. <Text_Accent>Good against light and medium tanks</>.
BTX_Pak38.facts: Turret RTS_BP_EmbTurret_Pak38, weapon Pak38_50MM: APHE, 1 round, 3.3 s reload, raised accuracy (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:4316). BxpData health T1*1.75 reinforced, cost 250 R / 150 M (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:8928-8937).
BTX_Pak38.offered_by: not offered: has data but is in no option list or layout

BTX_Ger37MMCaptureBunker.name: 37mm Flak Bunker
BTX_Ger37MMCaptureBunker.description: A concrete bunker with a 3.7 cm Flak 36 firing <Text_Weapon>6-round clips</>. Once captured it <Text_Accent>fights for you</>.
BTX_Ger37MMCaptureBunker.facts: BP Ger_Bxp_CaptureBunker37mm: child turret RTS_BP_EmbTurret_37mmFlak, weapon Flak36_37MM (6-round clip, 5 s reload, Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:4030). Map placed as BP_CaptureBunker_37MM (child of BP_CaptureActor, AmountCaptureUnitsNeeded), which spawns this BXP for the capturer. BxpData: health T2BxpHealth*2 = 1760, T1 vision, cost 700 R / 300 M, armed abilities (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:49-65).
BTX_Ger37MMCaptureBunker.offered_by: not offered: map-placed capture point (BP_CaptureBunker_37MM; survival start content, SurvivalStartContentSettings.cpp:273)

BTX_GerTurretCaptureBunker.name: Turret Bunker
BTX_GerTurretCaptureBunker.description: A concrete bunker with a Jaguar turret and its <Text_Weapon>35mm autocannon</> on 5-round clips. Once captured it <Text_Accent>fights for you</>.
BTX_GerTurretCaptureBunker.facts: BP Ger_Bxp_CaptureBunkerTurret: child turret Ger_Turret_Jaguar35mm, weapon Kwk32_35MM (35 mm, MagCapacity 5, reload 5 s, burst fire; Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/CPPGameState.cpp:3688-3701). Map placed as BP_CaptureBunker_Turret (child of BP_CaptureActor). BxpData: health T2BxpHealth*4 = 3520, T1 vision, cost 700 R / 300 M (Source/RTS_Survival/Game/GameState/BxpDataHelpers/BxpDataHelpers.h:68-84). Weapon enum display string says 'Kwk32 30MM' but calibre is 35.
BTX_GerTurretCaptureBunker.offered_by: not offered: map-placed capture point (BP_CaptureBunker_Turret; SurvivalStartContentSettings.cpp:274)

BTX_GerHQLaser.name: Laser Platform
BTX_GerHQLaser.description: The Panzer V/III turret on an HQ platform, firing its <Text_Weapon>Strahlkanone 39</> beam. The height gives it <Text_Accent>double range</> (+100%). Draws <Text_Accent>15 energy</>.
BTX_GerHQLaser.facts: Ger_Bxp_HQLaserPlatform BP: child turret Ger_Turret_PZV_III (Panzer V/III, weapon enum Strahlkanone39 'Strahlkanone 39 50MM PZ V/III'); BP adds BP_Beh_Weapon_HQDoubleRange like the Flak Platform. BxpData: 450 Rad + 150 Metal (user pick 2026-11-20), energy -15, health T1BxpHealth*1.5, build 30 s (BxpDataHelpers.h HQ Laser block).

BTX_GerFlak88Bunker.name: Flak 88 Bunker
BTX_GerFlak88Bunker.description: The Flak 88 pit's <Text_Weapon>8.8 cm Flak</> and crew in a concrete Flakstand. <Text_Accent>Strong against tanks at long range</>, with twice a heavy bunker's health.
BTX_GerFlak88Bunker.facts: Ger_BXP_Flak88Bunker: turret RTS_BP_EmbTurret_GerPit_Flak88 (the Flak 88 pit's crewed gun). BxpData gun-pit table: 900 Rad + 450 Metal, HealthMlt 2.0 x BxpHeavyBunkerHealth, build GerConcreteBunkerBuildTime (= rail Pak 40 s). Breakthrough HQ Barriers slot, needs Communication Center.
BTX_GerFlak88Bunker.offered_by: Breakthrough HQ field defense (TrainingMenuManager + DA_TrainingLayout Barriers)

BTX_GerFlakvierlingBunker.name: Flakvierling Bunker
BTX_GerFlakvierlingBunker.description: A <Text_Weapon>2 cm Flakvierling</> in an open concrete emplacement: four rapid-firing barrels. <Text_Accent>1.6x</> a heavy bunker's health.
BTX_GerFlakvierlingBunker.facts: Ger_BXP_FlakvierlingBunker: turret RTS_BP_EmbTurret_BF_Flakvierling (weapon Flak4_20mm). 600 Rad + 300 Metal, HealthMlt 1.6, 40 s. Breakthrough HQ Barriers slot, needs Communication Center.

BTX_GerPZ38TBunker.name: Pz 38(t) Turret Bunker
BTX_GerPZ38TBunker.description: A Pz 38(t) turret with its <Text_Weapon>3.7 cm KwK 38(t)</> on a round concrete pillbox. Cheap anti-tank cover with <Text_Accent>1.5x</> a heavy bunker's health.
BTX_GerPZ38TBunker.facts: Ger_BXP_PZ38TTurretBunker: turret Ger_Turret_PZ38T (KwK38_T_37MM); building mesh fixed 2026-11-20 to SM_BF_PZ38T_TurretBunker (was the capture bunker placeholder). 500 Rad + 250 Metal, HealthMlt 1.5, 40 s.
